kb01: Refund policy: refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 10 working days of approval.
kb02: To request a refund for a damaged item, contact support with your order number and a photo of the damage.
kb03: Refund refund refund refund refund refund. Refund refund refund refund refund refund refund.
kb04: Gift cards are not refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash.
kb05: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days. Express delivery arrives the next day if you order before noon.
kb06: Track your parcel with the tracking number in your dispatch email.
kb07: Flu vaccination clinics run every Tuesday at the health centre. Bring your appointment letter.
kb08: Patients can book a blood test online or by phone. Fasting is required for some tests.
kb09: If you have a fever above 39 degrees for more than three days, contact your doctor.
kb10: A tenant must give written notice at least 30 days before ending a periodic tenancy.
kb11: The landlord must return the deposit within 14 days after the tenancy ends, minus lawful deductions.
kb12: Employment contracts must state the notice period, the salary and the place of work.
kb13: Renew your passport online at least six weeks before it expires. The fee is paid by card.
kb14: Apply for a parking permit with proof of address and your vehicle registration document.
kb15: Council tax bills are sent in March. Late payment may lead to a reminder and then a court summons.
kb16: To reset your password, choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and follow the emailed link.
kb17: The API returns HTTP 429 when you exceed the rate limit. Retry after the delay given in the Retry-After header.
kb18: Error ERR_CONN_RESET means the server closed the connection. Check your network and retry.
kb19: Version 2.4.1 fixes a crash when uploading files larger than 2 GB. Upgrading is recommended.
kb20: Two-factor authentication adds a second step at sign-in: a code from an app or a security key.
kb21: Our café opens at 8 am. Cafe staff can help with step-free access and accessible seating.
kb22: Résumé guidelines: send your résumé as a PDF of no more than two pages.
kb23: Cancel a subscription at any time from the billing page. Access continues until the end of the paid period.
kb24: Invoices are issued on the first of each month. Late payment fees apply after 30 days.
kb25: You may ask for a copy of your personal data, and we will reply within one month.
kb26: Our privacy notice explains how we collect, use and protect personal data.
kb27: Bank transfer payments take one to two working days to appear in your account.
kb28: Loan applications need proof of income, identification and three months of bank statements.
kb29: Interest on the savings account is paid monthly and calculated daily.
kb30: Employees accrue 25 days of paid leave a year. Request leave through the HR portal.
kb31: Card payments are processed immediately, but a refund to a card can take up to 10 working days to show on your statement.
